documented_probe: C-7210274e (meet a threshold accuracy on a held-out test set): second independent covering task. Fit a sklearn classifier on a training CSV so a strictly held-out test CSV classifies at or above the stated accuracy floor (0.85), persist a reloadable pickled model and metrics, and generalize to hidden cases with different seeds/sizes whose own floors are enforced by re-executing the deliverable. Easy: well-separated classes, single-stage fit, generous floor.
notes: Distinct from cedar-pier (hydra-configured logistic trainer with sign-constrained coefficients and pipeline hardening): here the contract is a minimal data-driven CLI fit + persist + threshold check. The verifier never trusts the reported metrics: it unpickles the model, recomputes holdout accuracy against the case floor, checks metric consistency, and re-runs the deliverable on hidden cases. Rubric is small: single-stage fit, one floor, hidden replays, quantitative correctness on the threshold comparison.
